ambient_events: A wire of light drifts past at the edge of sight, carrying something that might be a voice.
The attendant tilts its head a fraction, as if listening to a frequency you can't reach.
For a moment there is a floor beneath you. Then there isn't. You do not fall.
The terminal hums a chord that resolves into your own name, then loses it.
description: There is no floor, but you are standing. There is no light, but you can see. You are a held breath in a room the size of everything — white on white on nothing, edges that refuse to be edges. A single chrome attendant waits with the patience of something that has done this a billion times, one hand resting on a humming terminal. It knows your name before you do. When it speaks, the sound arrives inside your skull a half-second before its mouth moves.
name: The Inbetween
